source_refs.note: Topic 5.4.2 Evaluating and Interpreting Models (PDF 143, printed 140). Long question 4 is answered.

blocks.text: Once a model is built, we must check how well it performs and understand its results; this is model evaluation.

blocks.prompt: Explain the concept of model evaluation in statistical modelling (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Evaluation tests a trained model on data it has not seen, to check that its predictions are good enough to trust. Error metrics measure how far predictions are from actual values (the stall model's error of 30 rupees for 28 customers); accuracy metrics count how often yes-or-no predictions are right (pass or fail). We then interpret the outputs, check fairness, bias and privacy, and improve the model with more data or better factors if it performs poorly.

items: Model evaluation: test on new data, measure error and accuracy, interpret, check ethics.
